_doc: Ordered list of captures for scripts/capture-sprint-01-ui.ts. One entry = one screenshot (plus a full-page copy when full=true).

session: guest (fresh context each time) | seed-talent | seed-employer (seed accounts, READ-ONLY) | dt | de (disposable Talent / Employer created by this run; their context persists across entries in order).

writes=true is only allowed on dt/de. Variables: ${RUN_ID} ${DT_EMAIL} ${DT_PASSWORD} ${DT_PASSWORD_NEW} ${DE_EMAIL} ${DE_PASSWORD} ${SEED_TALENT_EMAIL}; passwords are generated at runtime / read from env and never written to disk.

Steps: goto, click{name,role?,selector?,exact?}, fill{selector,value}, type{selector,value}, press, clear, scrollTo, wait, waitUrl, waitText, read{selector,var}, totp{var,into}, setVar{name,value}, localStorage{key,value}, download{name}, blockHosts[], newContext, select{selector,label}.
expect: [{url}|{text}|{notText}] — regex strings; all must hold for the entry to count as UI-verified.
